aide.title: Help & Support
aide.subtitle: Find answers to your questions
aide.faq1a: Go to the Meditations tab from the main menu. You will find daily meditations and archives.
aide.faq2q: How to make a donation to the church?
aide.faq2a: Go to Donations > New donation. Choose a campaign, the amount and your payment method.
aide.faq3a: The Services tab shows upcoming scheduled services. Join them live or watch replays.
aide.faq4a: From your Profile > Notification preferences, enable or disable the notification types you want.
aide.faq5q: How to edit my personal information?
aide.faq5a: On your Profile page, click "Edit profile" to update your information.
aide.faq6a: We accept credit cards (Visa, Mastercard), PayPal and Stripe payments.

landing.heroDescription: Join the first platform connecting EEC members across the world. Prayers, live services, donations and mutual aid — live your faith in community, without borders.
landing.aboutTitle: A living faith, a united community
landing.aboutDesc1: The Evangelical Church of Cameroon gathers members on every continent. DiaspoEEC was born from a simple dream: that every member, no matter where they are, can live their faith, contribute and stay connected to their home community.
landing.aboutDesc2: From Douala to Paris, from Yaounde to Montreal, from Bafoussam to Berlin — we are one family in Christ.
landing.aboutBibleQuote: "For where two or three gather in my name, there am I with them."
landing.featuresTitle: Everything to live your faith daily
landing.featuresSubtitle: A complete platform, lovingly designed for the needs of our community.
landing.featureDailyMeditationsDesc: Start each day with a meditation inspired by the Word. Bible readings, guided prayers and spiritual reflections.
landing.featureEventsCultesDesc: Find all events from your parish and the global community. Registration, reminders and sharing in one click.
landing.featureOnlineDonationsDesc: Support church projects through secure donations. Tithes, offerings and contributions to special campaigns.
landing.featureBibleGuideDesc: Explore the Bible with personalized reading plans, pastoral commentaries and study groups.
landing.featureLiveServicesDesc: Follow live services from anywhere in the world. Replays available and notifications before each broadcast.
landing.featureCommunityDesc: Connect with members from around the world. Prayer groups, discussion forums and mutual support among brothers and sisters.
landing.donationSubtitle: Every donation, big or small, helps build a stronger and more united community.
landing.campaignDescription: A gathering place for the entire EEC diaspora in the Paris region.
landing.donationBibleQuote: "Whoever sows generously will also reap generously."
landing.testimonialsTitle: They live their faith with DiaspoEEC
landing.testimonial1Text: Since I started using DiaspoEEC, I feel connected to my parish in Douala as if I were still there. Live services and daily meditations nourish my faith every day.
landing.testimonial2Text: The online donation feature has transformed the way we contribute. I can support my church projects in Cameroon directly from my phone, securely.
landing.testimonial3Text: Online prayer groups have been an extraordinary blessing. Despite the distance, I pray every week with my brothers and sisters from Cameroon, Europe and America.
landing.downloadAppDesc: Take your community everywhere with you. Meditations, live services, donations and much more — all in your pocket.
landing.footerDescription: The digital platform of the Evangelical Church of Cameroon for the diaspora. United in faith, connected by technology.
landing.footerCopyright: © 2026 Evangelical Church of Cameroon. All rights reserved.
